title: Pendulous
summary: PEND'ULOUS, a. [L. pendulus, from pendeo, to hang.] Hanging; swinging; fastened to one end, the other being movable. The dewlap of an animal is pendulous.

inlines.v: PEND'ULOUS, a. [L. pendulus, from pendeo, to hang.] Hanging; swinging; fastened to one end, the other being movable. The dewlap of an animal is pendulous.
